== Ingredients ==
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] dry red [[Cookbook:Lentil|lentils]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] water or [[Cookbook:Stock|stock]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaf]]

== Procedure ==
#[[File:Lentil soup done.jpg|thumb|Finished lentil soup, with potatoes, parsley, and dill added|308x308px]]Pick over the lentils to remove any debris if needed. Rinse well.
#Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once oil is hot, add the onion and carrots. [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] for a few minutes, until the vegetables have started to soften, then add the garlic.
#Add the lentils, bay leaf, and water to the pot. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] over low-medium heat for 20–30 minutes until lentils are softened. 
#Serve hot.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Herbs and/or spices can be added to the sautéing vegetables, such as [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]], [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]], and/or [[Cookbook:Red Pepper|red pepper]] flakes.  
* [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|Hot sauce]] can be added to taste. Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]] is a nice addition, preferably immediately before serving.
